text: {"lessons":["My trades in A show the risk of changing course repeatedly: set a clear reason and plan before buying or selling, and reassess it rather than reacting to price moves.","Selling at a loss can be sensible, but repeated sales below cost across several stocks are a cue to review whether my decisions are based on evidence and portfolio risk, not fear or regret.","A rising account over a few periods does not show that I am beating the market; track returns against a suitable benchmark over the long run before judging my approach."]}
